# has temporal measurement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-hasTemporalMeasurement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTemporalMeasurement>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity (event, artifact, place, sample) to a temporal measurement assigned to it.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasTemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-hasTemporalMeasurement.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) to the thing it dates — an artifact, sample, place, or named period — making the dating claim discoverable from the dated entity.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for stating a plain known date (assert a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) directly) and avoid using it to carry the result value; the measurement relator holds method, age, and uncertainty, this edge only links to it.

### How to use

- Point the dated entity at one or more [`gmeow:TemporalMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalMeasurement.md) relators; on a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md), a measurement whose [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md) is an [`Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) feeds the [`gmeow:periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) property chain.

### Examples

- ex:hearthSample [`gmeow:hasTemporalMeasurement`](gmeow-hasTemporalMeasurement.md) ex:charcoalDate.
